environment: Python 3.14.7, Node test runner, cli-runner testkit (scratch HOME, TZ=UTC), scratch git repo, branches.py from a worktree of sdlc/S-008

cases.title: run-N gives kind run with an integer n
cases.given: Scratch git repo, shipped branches.py, format sdlc/{name}
cases.when: branches.py parse for run-3, run-0, run-12, run-007, run-x, run-, run-3-x, run--1
cases.then: Exit 0. run-3, run-0, run-12 and run-007 give kind run, n 3, 0, 12 and 7 as integers, and no id. The others give kind null. The repo tree does not change.
cases.expected: Exit 0. run-3, run-0, run-12 and run-007 give kind run, n 3, 0, 12 and 7 as integers, and no id. The others give kind null. The repo tree does not change.
cases.actual: Exit 0. run-3, run-0, run-12 and run-007 give kind run, n 3, 0, 12 and 7 as integers, and no id. The others give kind null. The repo tree does not change.

cases.title: M-N gives milestone and never swallows e2e tails
cases.given: Scratch git repo, shipped branches.py, format sdlc/{name}
cases.when: parse M-2, M-, M-x, M-2-e2e, M-2-e2e-api, m-2 (default and {name:lower})
cases.then: M-2 is milestone. M- and M-x are null. E2e tails are not milestone. m-2 is null by default and milestone under {name:lower}.
cases.expected: M-2 is milestone. M- and M-x are null. E2e tails are not milestone. m-2 is null by default and milestone under {name:lower}.
cases.actual: M-2 is milestone. M- and M-x are null. E2e tails are not milestone. m-2 is null by default and milestone under {name:lower}.

cases.title: M-N-e2e gives kind e2e and an area tail does not
cases.given: Scratch git repo, shipped branches.py, format sdlc/{name}
cases.when: parse M-2-e2e, M-2-e2e-api, M-2-e2e-, M-2-e2e-x, M-2-e2ex
cases.then: M-2-e2e is e2e with id M-2. M-2-e2e-api is not e2e. M-2-e2e- and M-2-e2ex are null.
cases.expected: M-2-e2e is e2e with id M-2. M-2-e2e-api is not e2e. M-2-e2e- and M-2-e2ex are null.
cases.actual: M-2-e2e is e2e with id M-2. M-2-e2e-api is not e2e. M-2-e2e- and M-2-e2ex are null.

cases.title: e2e-area keeps a dashed area whole
cases.given: Scratch git repo, shipped branches.py, format sdlc/{name}
cases.when: parse M-2-e2e-<area> for api-v2, a, 0, e2e, v2-api-3 and a 500-character area
cases.then: Kind e2e-area, id M-2 and the full area text for each.
cases.expected: Kind e2e-area, id M-2 and the full area text for each.
cases.actual: Kind e2e-area, id M-2 and the full area text for each.

cases.title: First-match order under prefixed and suffixed formats
cases.given: Scratch git repo, shipped branches.py, format sdlc/{name}
cases.when: parse rows 1 to 4 under feature/PROJ-1-{name} and {name}-wip; M-2-e2e-api-wip; wrong prefix; missing suffix
cases.then: Each row classifies as under the default format. The area is api. A wrong prefix or a missing suffix gives kind null.
cases.expected: Each row classifies as under the default format. The area is api. A wrong prefix or a missing suffix gives kind null.
cases.actual: Each row classifies as under the default format. The area is api. A wrong prefix or a missing suffix gives kind null.

cases.title: Hostile tails never crash and never gain a kind (except TC-cli-7)
cases.given: Scratch git repo, shipped branches.py, format sdlc/{name}
cases.when: parse 25 hostile tails: newline, tab, CR, unicode digits, flag-like values, control characters, slash in area, 5000-digit M-N, 4300-digit run-N, empty
cases.then: Exit 0 with one JSON object, no traceback, tree unchanged. A NUL argument gives a spawn error. An unknown flag gives a nonzero exit.
cases.expected: Exit 0 with one JSON object, no traceback, tree unchanged. A NUL argument gives a spawn error. An unknown flag gives a nonzero exit.
cases.actual: Exit 0 with one JSON object, no traceback, tree unchanged. A NUL argument gives a spawn error. An unknown flag gives a nonzero exit.
cases.specSource: R-102 to R-105 quotes; ADR-20261009-173303-decision-judge-S-008-a88a for the slash

evidence.title: Repo tree after each parse call
evidence.inline: treeUnchanged is true for all 25 calls.

evidence.title: Result matrix: tail, exit, kind, id or n, area

cases.title: run-N with 5000 digits gives one JSON object, not a traceback
cases.given: Scratch git repo, shipped branches.py, format sdlc/{name}
cases.then: Exit 0 or 2 with one JSON object on stdout and no traceback.
cases.expected: Exit 0 or 2 with one JSON object on stdout and no traceback.
cases.actual: Exit 1, empty stdout, stderr holds a traceback that ends in ValueError at branches.py line 150 (int(value) in parse).
cases.specSource: Spec branches.py section: every command prints one JSON object, and exits 2 with {ok:false,error} on bad input

seeds.title: parse accepts a trailing newline
seeds.detail:
Python $ matches before a final newline. sdlc/M-2
 gives milestone M-2, run-3
 gives run n 3, M-2-e2e
 gives e2e, and M-2-e2e-api
 gives area api. The tail field keeps the newline. Git refuses newlines in branch names, so only a direct call reaches this.

seeds.title: parse treats unicode digits as digits
seeds.detail: sdlc/run-٣ gives n 3, sdlc/M-٢ gives milestone M-٢, and sdlc/M-2-e2e-١ gives area ١. The pattern \d matches non-ASCII digits. The plan keeps this behavior.

seeds.title: slash in an area is accepted (note only)
seeds.detail: sdlc/M-2-e2e-a/b gives kind e2e-area with area a/b. ADR-20261009-173303-decision-judge-S-008-a88a keeps this behavior.
